mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses the risk-free rate, reducing equity discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors shift to risk assets.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the federal funds rate above 0.5% signals imminent monetary tightening, increasing equity discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in unemployment rate and increases in non-farm payrolls indicate a tightening labor market that boosts corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of UNRATE decline and PAYEMS increase fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime defined by housing starts above 1200 thousand units and quarterly GDP growth exceeding 2.5%, the S&P 500 underperforms due to overvaluation and policy tightening, generating negative forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where HOUST exceeds 1200 and GDPC1 growth rate exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate below 4.5% signals a tight labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate profit margins, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE remains below 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in industrial production below 100 indicates manufacturing weakness that reduces corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO is below 100.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in core inflation and federal funds rate signal aggressive monetary policy to combat inflation, increasing equity discount rates and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of CPIAUCSL increase and FEDFUNDS rise fails to produce negative 5-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a high supply growth regime defined by industrial production above 105, strong manufacturing activity supports corporate earnings and economic expansion, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 105.
